## Goal and planning ID

What player or developer outcome should change? Use a backlog ID if applicable; it is separate from this issue number.

## Current evidence

Commit, relevant source/tests, current behaviour and constraints.

## Proposed scope

Smallest useful implementation; dependencies and decisions; related work to defer.

## Acceptance

Observable scenarios, validation commands/results needed, compatibility and rollback.

## Documentation

Documents/catalogues that must change. Use docs/embervale/08-templates/FEATURE_SPEC.md for the fuller template.
